book.name: Amatiu
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ Amatiu Age̠ Bho̠

content: Igiel bho̠ A̠zizo̠s na̠ a̠mite na̠ ad̠u̠a d̠a̠ otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠, sa̠ ogbo atu̠ghan d̠o̠yo̠ iru ra̠ i̠tu̠o̠gho̠m inigha̠ i̠na ma̠ eloma̠ otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠.

content.text: “Inyin na̠ o̠bi̠gh i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n? Ya̠gia̠ga̠i, ami̠ na̠ agba na̠ a̠nigha̠ inyin, ekpo ikputu ola̠ ta̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ anyu̠ ta̠ opa̠n ola̠ ko ob̠ogion d̠o̠ bo̠.”

content: Sa̠ agu̠o̠ A̠zizo̠s aro̠ ma̠ a̠dila̠de d̠a̠ igu Roliv bho̠, sa̠ ogbo atu̠ghan d̠o̠yo̠ iru d̠o̠yo̠ ra̠ ifugh ma̠a̠, “Gba ma̠ a̠nigha̠ i̠yar, a̠kere obhel wa̠ i̠nye̠n ta̠ emite bho̠, na̠ ere wa̠ ta̠ aro̠ ma̠ elegh eruoma̠ d̠oyom na̠ ekunuguma̠ e̠mara̠nwunom bho̠?”
Sa̠ A̠zizo̠s awo̠ran agba a̠nigha̠ awa ma̠a̠:

content.text: “I̠mare̠ ma̠ ekpona̠ ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ o̠ni̠ ko ogelemeni d̠o̠ inyin.
A̠d̠izo a̠nwunom ta̠ ebhin a̠d̠ien d̠ami̠ eru, sa̠ ta̠ e̠gba ma̠a̠, ‘Ami̠ Akrai̠st,’ sa̠ ta̠ egelemeni ma̠ a̠d̠izo ogbo.
Inyin ta̠ o̠mu̠gho̠n i̠mu̠mu̠gho̠n re̠gham, o̠ni̠ okpa̠ra̠numa̠ d̠o̠. I̠di̠ar ya̠ o̠ku̠a ta̠ emite, ya̠a̠ ekunuguma̠ obhel bho̠ ta̠ olei d̠o̠.
Ebhugh ta̠ ewia̠n ebhugh, sa̠ irileghom ta̠ ewia̠n irileghom. Ibom ro̠ko̠i̠ ta̠ esor, sa̠ ra̠de ta̠ enyegia̠n eb̠omia̠n ekurubh, d̠a̠ a̠d̠izo a̠risi.
Ya̠a̠, eb̠la̠ i̠nye̠n kisa̠ ob̠eton ali̠gam a̠ruzu bho̠.
“Igiel o̠ku̠a, ta̠ ob̠eton inyin onigha̠ ma̠ ogbo ya̠ ta̠ e̠ni̠ni̠gi̠o̠m inyin, sa̠ ta̠ egigh inyin, sa̠ eb̠la̠ ibhebhia̠n bho̠ ta̠ e̠lo̠gh inyin a̠d̠ien d̠a̠ ebula̠ a̠d̠ien d̠ami̠.
Igiel o̠ku̠a, a̠d̠izo ogbo ta̠ emel e̠d̠u̠a d̠a̠ ologi ima̠ra̠ bho̠, sa̠ odi ta̠ a̠luom odi, sa̠ awa ta̠ e̠lo̠gi̠an a̠rid̠ien,
sa̠ a̠d̠izo a̠riwil igunugha̠ ta̠ emite egelemeni ma̠ a̠d̠izo ogbo.
Sa̠ ebula̠ agu̠o̠ a̠ma̠rugh i̠te̠i̠ ta̠ a̠kpegiom a̠nwunom bho̠, etula̠n ta̠ aki̠r d̠a̠ esa̠d̠io a̠d̠izo ogbo.
Ya̠a̠ o̠ni̠ wa̠ a̠ne ka̠ ate̠i̠ d̠a̠ ekunuguma̠ bho̠ ta̠ a̠ten.
Sa̠ ta̠ o̠gba ma̠ ib̠eb̠i asu̠gbagba irileghom bho̠ d̠a̠ eb̠la̠ e̠mara̠nwunom ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ ko̠ni̠ko̠ni̠ ta̠ amu̠gho̠n, sa̠ ekunuguma̠ obhel bho̠ ta̠ a̠lei.

“O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, igiel inyin u̠bi̠gh ka̠ abar ola̠ omitegha̠n d̠o̠ na̠ a̠mite amara d̠a̠ esi e̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠, sa̠ i̠d̠i̠ar na̠ e̠pi̠e̠gi̠an, ma̠ agu̠o̠ owil Adani̠e̠l a̠wa̠ bho̠ (o̠ni̠ wa̠ na̠ a̠sen bho̠ amu̠gho̠nyan),
bha̠, ogbo ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ A̠zudia̠, eghil ebhun d̠a̠ rebhugh ya̠ i̠gi̠ ma̠ anyu̠ bho̠.
O̠ni̠ wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ anyu̠ otu bho̠ osor d̠o̠ ka̠ a̠bhin abar d̠a̠ otu d̠o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ o̠ni̠ wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ od̠ighi bho̠ omula̠ d̠o̠ ka̠ a̠bhin ibura̠ d̠o̠yo̠.
Ya̠a̠ ekulom anwani̠ a̠rughun na̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ enigha̠ ma̠ amu̠mam bho̠, d̠a̠ ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ i̠ye̠,
Isiseinye ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ e̠d̠u̠a d̠inyin ko osora̠n d̠o̠ d̠a̠ obhel a̠d̠igho, bo̠d̠o̠ d̠a̠ A̠d̠a̠ma̠ Osira̠ Epobh bho̠.

Ezin bho̠, ka̠ a̠sora̠n d̠a̠ igiel ola̠ o̠ku̠a, ali̠gam a̠ruzu bho̠ ta̠ a̠peleni ka̠ ate̠i̠ esi ola̠, ta̠ o̠bi̠gh ma̠ abar ola̠ oku̠a ta̠ od̠ia̠ d̠o̠ a̠mite ma̠ obhin d̠a̠ o̠pu̠r ob̠eton e̠mara̠nwunom bho̠ ra̠ o̠te̠i̠ i̠se̠n, ya̠ ko omite mu nyen.
“Sa̠ ku̠gba ma̠a̠, ukperemeni d̠o̠ ma̠ obhel bho̠, bebina̠ o̠ni̠ ola̠ ta̠ a̠miza̠n a̠d̠um bo̠. Ya̠a̠, d̠a̠ ebula̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ o̠so̠n bho̠, ta̠ okperemeni ma̠ obhel obha̠.
Igiel o̠ku̠a, ku̠gba ma̠ o̠ni̠ agba a̠nigha̠ inyin ma̠a̠, ‘Bi̠ghe̠, Akrai̠st od̠i ma̠ i̠se̠n!’ Bo̠d̠o̠, ‘Od̠i ma̠ ebha̠!’ O̠ni̠ ko od̠umom.
Ra̠krai̠st igunugha̠ na̠ a̠riwil igunugha̠ ta̠ emite sa̠ ta̠ eleriom ibom relegh na̠ ogir ilologia̠n, ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ a̠b̠ur nab̠o̠, ka̠ igelemeni nyen ogbo ya̠ na̠ o̠so̠n bho̠.
I̠bi̠ghe̠! Ami̠ na̠ a̠d̠ia̠ agba a̠nigha̠ inyin.

“O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, ku̠gba ma̠ o̠ni̠ agba a̠nigha̠ inyin ma̠a̠, ‘I̠bi̠ghe̠, od̠i d̠a̠ e̠ghana bho̠,’ ko o̠gi̠ ka̠ e̠bi̠ghan; bo̠d̠o̠, ‘I̠bi̠ghe̠, od̠i d̠a̠ e̠bhai̠, esi e̠wo̠gi̠na’ ko oma̠ra̠.
Ezin bho̠, agu̠o̠ i̠me̠me̠gi̠na agbararan, ka̠ a̠mite d̠a̠ opu omite ogogo bho̠, sa̠ na̠ awar na̠ a̠misi d̠a̠ osor ogogo bho̠, obha̠ agu̠o̠ eruoma̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ ta̠ aro̠.
Kesikesi ola̠ e̠b̠u̠re̠ od̠i, obha̠ esi ro̠de̠le̠ bho̠ na̠ ekokod̠ia̠n bho̠.
“Ali̠gam a̠ruzu ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ i̠nye̠n ma̠ oten ku̠ku̠m bha̠,
“ ‘Ogogo bho̠ o̠zu̠,
sa̠ uwetere bho̠ ko o̠mu̠ mu̠;
re̠ni̠nai̠ny bho̠ ta̠ e̠d̠u̠a d̠a̠ e̠nai̠ny emeleghu,
sa̠ ra̠limon ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ re̠nai̠ny bho̠ ta̠ enyegia̠n.’

“D̠a̠ obhel obha̠, sa̠ elegh O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ ta̠ a̠mite d̠a̠ e̠nai̠ny, sa̠ eb̠la̠ rebhugh e̠mara̠nwunom bho̠ ta̠ ed̠igh i̠ku̠nu̠. Sa̠ awa ta̠ e̠bi̠gh ka̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ na̠ a̠ru d̠a̠ o̠b̠u̠ghu̠b̠ugh ote̠nai̠ny na̠ a̠limon na̠ ibom isosorogia̠n.

Sa̠ ta̠ a̠ruom itileduom d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ opughe od̠od̠ue obom oghur, sa̠ ta̠ ekokod̠i ma̠ ogbo ya̠ i̠na na̠ aso̠n d̠a̠ inya̠ re̠ku̠l bho̠, obeton d̠a̠ ekunuguma̠ odi agba a̠de na̠ e̠nai̠ny o̠gi̠ ka̠ o̠te̠i̠ d̠a̠ esumogha̠n bho̠.
“I̠tu̠ghane̠ ma̠ a̠sidogh oriren a̠fig bho̠: Igiel bha̠ i̠gha na̠ edugh na̠ a̠nwegina̠ ma̠ a̠to, bha̠ inyin ologhom ma̠ a̠kozogh na̠ a̠tua̠n.
Obha̠ agu̠o̠ od̠i nyen, igiel inyin u̠bi̠gh eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n, iloghome ma̠ obhel bho̠ od̠i d̠a̠ e̠b̠ab̠a agu̠o̠, na̠ a̠misi d̠a̠ o̠nu̠ otu.
Ya̠gia̠ga̠i, ami̠ na̠ agba na̠ a̠nigha̠ inyin ma̠a̠, amu̠m onon ka̠ oten d̠o̠ a̠munia̠n kisa̠ eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n ta̠ emite.
A̠de na̠ e̠nai̠ny ta̠ eten e̠d̠u̠a, ya̠a̠ atu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ d̠ami̠ ko oten d̠o̠ e̠d̠u̠a.

content: O̠ni̠ ola̠ a̠loghom A̠d̠a̠ma̠ na̠ obhel bho̠ bo̠

content.text: “Ya̠ igboloma̠ ma̠ ologhom a̠d̠a̠ma̠ bho̠ na̠ obhel bho̠, o̠ni̠ ola̠ a̠loghom bo̠, a̠d̠igh itileduom ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ ote̠nai̠ny bho̠, a̠d̠igh O̠nyi̠ bho̠. O̠we̠de̠ bho̠ ku̠ku̠m a̠loghom.
Agu̠o̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ obhel ta̠ A̠nua̠ bho̠, obha̠ agu̠o̠ eruoma̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ ta̠ aro̠.

Ezin bho̠ agu̠o̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ obhel bho̠, kisa̠ obom amu̠m a̠d̠igho bho̠ a̠ru bho̠, a̠nwunom na̠ ed̠e na̠ e̠d̠a, na̠ ebhinogh ranwani̠ na̠ enigha̠nom ra̠nwi̠i̠nyan, tu̠tu̠n d̠a̠ a̠d̠a̠ma̠ wa̠ A̠nua̠ a̠d̠igh d̠a̠ ologi obom oghugh bho̠;
sa̠ iloghom d̠o̠ ma̠ i̠d̠i̠ar ya̠ ta̠ emite tu̠tu̠n obom amu̠m a̠d̠igho bho̠ a̠ru, sa̠ aze̠ ko̠ni̠ko̠ni̠. Obha̠ agu̠o̠ eruoma̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ ta̠ aro̠ nyen.
D̠a̠ obhel obha̠, i̠wal o̠ni̠ ta̠ e̠ro̠ d̠a̠ o̠si̠, ta̠ obhin odi sa̠ ta̠ o̠we̠le̠ ma̠ uwed̠i.
I̠wal anwani̠ ta̠ e̠ro̠ ma̠ esi o̠gbe̠ ed̠ia̠n na̠ e̠gbe̠ ma̠ ed̠ian, sa̠ ta̠ obhin odi o̠we̠le̠ ma̠ uwed̠i.
“O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, igone, ezin bho̠ inyin uloghom d̠o̠ ma̠ a̠d̠a̠ma̠ wa̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ d̠inyin ta̠ a̠ru bho̠.
I̠mare̠ ma̠ e̠mu̠gho̠nyan abar onon. Ku̠gba ma̠ wa̠nwuna̠ ma̠ otu bho̠ a̠loghom obhel wa̠ o̠gba bho̠ ta̠ a̠ru bho̠ nab̠o̠, i̠na ka̠ i̠ro̠ ma̠ omom a̠kigima̠ ma̠ o̠gba bho̠ ma̠ ob̠om otu bho̠ od̠igh.
Ebula̠ o̠ku̠a, inyin eka̠ ikokod̠ia̠ne, ezin bho̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ O̠ni̠ ta̠ a̠ru ma̠ obhel ola̠ inyin o̠ru̠ru̠an d̠o̠.
“I̠se̠, ka̠ a̠nyen a̠ga̠i ob̠a̠ra̠motu wa̠ a̠loghom abar bho̠, ola̠ wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ ta̠ a̠sibh, ma̠ okponom rob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠ onigha̠ awa ma̠ ed̠ia̠n d̠a̠ obhel wa̠ akpe̠ bho̠?
E̠b̠e̠l ob̠a̠ra̠motu wa̠ ka̠ wa̠nwuna̠ i̠na bho̠ a̠ru, sa̠ ta̠ abi̠gh ma̠ i̠na na̠ amar na̠ a̠gir bho̠.
Ya̠gia̠ga̠i, ami̠ na̠ agba na̠ a̠nigha̠ inyin, wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ ta̠ a̠b̠eton eb̠la̠ e̠li̠la d̠o̠yo̠ a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠ okponom.
Ya̠a̠, ku̠gba ma̠ ob̠a̠ra̠motu obha̠ ma̠ o̠karabh o̠ni̠, sa̠ aru̠ru̠an d̠a̠ ologi d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠a̠, ‘Wa̠nwuna̠ d̠ami̠ ta̠ a̠bia̠ ma̠ oru,’
sa̠ ake̠ ma̠ od̠ulogh rob̠a̠ra̠motu iyed̠i, sa̠ na̠ a̠d̠e na̠ ad̠a na̠ ro̠d̠amin.
Wa̠nwuna̠ ma̠ ob̠a̠ra̠motu bho̠ ta̠ a̠ru ma̠ a̠d̠a̠ma̠ ola̠ i̠na o̠ru̠ru̠an d̠o̠, na̠ obhel ola̠ i̠na ologhoma̠n d̠o̠.
Sa̠ ta̠ agu̠r i̠na ma̠ obom agu̠o̠ i̠zagba, sa̠ ta̠ alo̠gh i̠na d̠a̠ agba ibhelebhel bho̠: i̠se̠ esi bho̠ ed̠i na̠ o̠ghi̠r ib̠ub̠ura̠ od̠i.
